rules: each hero (resident) lives in exactly one room at a time
a hero can be reassigned to a different room (cosmetic, design-only)
each hero contributes a UNIQUE resident bonus when assigned
resident bonus shape depends on identity (hero_id) + role + rarity
resident bonus is design-only; no battle runtime attached
resident bonus does not change Borea visibility, does not unlock primordial_gaia, does not affect AF2-N
resident bonus respects mode-cap, category-cap, master-cap
